$$
{f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,1.5)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3(1+2{y}^{2})}{5}, & \,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. Find the conditional expected value $\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1.5]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1.5)$ is shown above.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14205870/assets/f4bbfac6f9abcb9f3d8c6ddcc1f70860d8ec61fb9d47549b11e722355533dfa8.svg) 

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. Find the conditional expected value $\textrm{E}\big[Y \,|\, X=1\big]$ given that the conditional probability density function $f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, 1)$ is shown above.
current_example.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional expected value of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\textrm E\big[ Y \,|\, X = x \big] = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} y \, f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, x) \; \textrm{d}y.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }y\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y\cdot \frac{3(1+{y}^{2})}{4}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}(y+{y}^{3})\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{4}{[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}+\frac{{y}^{4}}{4}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}-0) \\  & =\frac{9}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$
